name: Firebeard's Head
summary: Firebeard’s Head is the proof demanded for Andre Firebeard’s warrant at Steamwheedle Port. The port’s law allows his head to stand in for him at trial.

sections.title: A Binding Warrant
sections.body: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle accepts Andre Firebeard’s head as a proxy for his hearing. The warrant names the pirate for crimes against Steamwheedle and Gadgetzan. Once you bring the head to the port, Bilgewhizzle treats the contract as fulfilled and offers payment for your service.

faq.q: Why does the warrant ask for his head?
faq.answer: The warrant says Andre Firebeard’s head may serve as his proxy if he is dead or unable to attend his hearing. Security Chief Bilgewhizzle accepts it at Steamwheedle Port.
Andre Firebeard is a pirate wanted for crimes against Steamwheedle and Gadgetzan.
Security Chief Bilgewhizzle takes Andre Firebeard’s head at Steamwheedle Port.
Steamwheedle Port lies on the coast of Tanaris. Andre Firebeard’s warrant is posted there.
